title: Riverbend Patient Financial Services Policy: One Open Patient Payment Plan per Patient
content:
**1. Rule.** A patient holds at most one open **Patient Payment Plan** at a time — at most 1 plan in pending signature, active or past due status, the tier's limit on open plans being 1 on every tier. Paid-off, cancelled and defaulted plans remain on the patient's profile as history.

**2. Where balances go.** Every eligible balance the patient wants on a plan goes into that one plan, either at creation or as an add-on.

**3. New plans.** A new plan cannot be created while another plan of the patient is open; to restructure, the patient first cancels the open plan, and its remaining balance is then enrolled with the other balances in the new plan.

### Status reading (derived from clause 1)

| Status of a plan on the patient's profile | Counts as the patient's open plan |
|---|---|
| pending signature | Yes |
| active | Yes |
| past due | Yes |
| paid off | No — history |
| cancelled | No — history |
| defaulted | No — history |

A hypothetical patient with one paid-off plan and one defaulted plan on the profile holds no open plan; a patient with an offer still in pending signature holds one.
